# rediscloud_iris_agent_memory (Resource)

An Iris Agent Memory store backed by an existing Redis Cloud database.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rediscloud_iris_agent_memory" "example" {
  name                         = "application-memory"
  database_id                  = "your-database-id"
  long_term_memory_ttl_seconds = 86400
  flush_on_delete              = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String) Redis Cloud database ID. Changing the database replaces the store.
- `name` (String) Name of the memory store.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `built_in_detector` (Block Set) A selected built-in sensitive-data detector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--built_in_detector))
- `built_in_detectors_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the built-in detector group.
- `classification_api_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Classification API key. Write-only; omitted from plan and state. Increment classification_api_key_version to rotate. Omit the key and its version for providers that require no credentials.
- `classification_api_key_version` (Number) Positive credential rotation version. Increment whenever classification_api_key changes.
- `classification_model` (String) Classification model.
- `classification_provider` (String) Classification provider.
- `custom_detector` (Block Set) A custom regular-expression sensitive-data detector. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom_detector))
- `custom_detectors_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the custom detector group.
- `custom_memory_type` (Block Set) Initial custom memory types. Retained from configuration because the store API does not return them; changes replace the store. Use the memory-type resource for ongoing CRUD. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--custom_memory_type))
- `embedding_api_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Embedding API key. Write-only; omitted from plan and state. Increment embedding_api_key_version to rotate. Omit the key and its version for providers that require no credentials.
- `embedding_api_key_version` (Number) Positive credential rotation version. Increment whenever embedding_api_key changes.
- `embedding_model` (String) Embedding model.
- `embedding_provider` (String) Embedding provider.
- `exclusions_enabled` (Boolean) Enable sensitive-data exclusions.
- `extraction_interval_seconds` (Number) Interval between extraction runs in seconds.
- `extraction_strategy` (String) Memory extraction strategy.
- `flush_on_delete` (Boolean) Delete short-term sessions on destroy. Long-term memories are retained.
- `llm_api_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) LLM API key. Write-only; omitted from plan and state. Increment llm_api_key_version to rotate. Omit the key and its version for providers that require no credentials.
- `llm_api_key_version` (Number) Positive credential rotation version. Increment whenever llm_api_key changes.
- `llm_model` (String) LLM model.
- `llm_provider` (String) LLM provider.
- `long_term_memory_ttl_seconds` (Number) Long-term memory TTL in seconds.
- `ownership_mode` (String) Ownership policy. INHERIT uses the tenant or global default.
- `semantic_exclusions_enabled` (Boolean) Enable semantic sensitive-data exclusions.
- `semantic_exclusions_prompt` (String) Instructions describing what semantic exclusion should remove.
- `session_summary_enabled` (Boolean) Extract session summaries into long-term memory.
- `short_memory_ttl_seconds` (Number) Short-term memory TTL in seconds.
- `summarization_enabled` (Boolean) Condense long sessions into a running summary.
- `summarization_event_threshold` (Number) Event count for session summarization.
- `summarization_retain_count` (Number) Number of recent events to retain after summarization.
- `summarization_trigger_strategy` (String) Session summarization trigger.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) UTC creation timestamp.
- `endpoints` (Set of Object) API endpoints for accessing the store. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))
- `failure_message` (String) Failure message when the store is unavailable.
- `failure_occurred_at` (String) UTC timestamp of the provisioning failure.
- `id` (String) Resource identifier used for import.
- `ownership_enabled` (Boolean) Whether ownership checks are effective.
- `ownership_source` (String) Source of the effective ownership policy: STORE, TENANT or GLOBAL.
- `state` (String) Provisioning state; READY means the store is usable.
- `subscription_id` (String) Database subscription ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rediscloud_iris_agent_memory.example st_11111111111111111111111111111111
```
